summary: IRSA Inversiones y Representaciones S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting its annual financial results for fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, in compliance with Buenos Aires Stock Exchange regulations. The filing discloses net income of ARS 420,977 million, equity details, share capital, and the controlling stake held by Cresud S.A.C.I.F. y A. (55.14% of shares). The report highlights operational performance across shopping malls, offices, and hotels, plus portfolio expansions. No corporate event such as merger, tender offer, or restructuring is presented; this is a routine earnings and regulatory disclosure.
